== list at 80
IN THE LIST
j/k ↑/↓       move                                                              
< > Home End  top / bottom                                                      
ctrl-d/u      half page down / up                                               
PgDn / PgUp   page down / up                                                    
Enter         open the task                                                     
Space         mark the task, then the next row; the footer acts on the marked   
J / K         page down / up                                                    
H / L         mark the previous / next column                                   
o             order by the marked column: ▲ ▼ off                               
t / d / x     take / done / drop the task                                       
e             edit in $VISUAL, else $EDITOR, git core.editor, vi                
m             grab to move: j/k move it, Enter places it                        
y, P p        yank, then paste above / below                                    
c             clear all filters                                                 
g             group rows: flat, group, epic, tag (tag: first listed tag)        

EVERYWHERE
v o            view: overview                                                   
v l            view: list                                                       
v b            view: board                                                      
v !            view: lint                                                       
/              find: Enter shows results, Tab keeps it as a filter              
:              palette: commands with completion                                
: commands     overview, list, board, todo, doing, done, depends, dropped, state
               <s>, type <t>, priority <p>, group <g>, tag <t>, assignee <a>,   
               epic <id>, goto <id>, sort, grouping, lint, clear, help          
#              jump by id prefix or TASK-number alias                           
f              filter picker: s t p g l a e (state type priority …)             
s              sort picker: c column, p t s u d g a n; again flips              
Backspace / F  remove the last chip / clear all filters                         
: sort         order by fields; s r or : sort rank goes back                    
N              new task                                                         
S              copy the screen, attach: id, s select, c create                  
r              request: ask the agents for a change; Enter sends                
Enter / Esc    confirm / cancel every editing action                            
e again        after an edit left a finding: edit at once                       
? / F1         this help (F1 in a text field); / finds in it                    
Esc            back one level, never quits                                      
q / ctrl-c     quit (q only outside inputs)

== palette at 80
IN THE : PALETTE
Tab          complete the choice                                                
Enter        complete, or run a complete command                                
↑↓ ctrl-n/p  pick a completion                                                  
Esc          up a level; on the top level, close                                
↑ empty      recall earlier commands, ↑ again older, ↓ newer; Enter runs it     
TASK id      the task you are in or on: take, done, drop, edit, note, set, move,
             mv, dep ...                                                        
CHECK n      with a check focused: tick or untick, strike, promote              
GLOBAL       view, filter (state, type, priority, group, tag, assignee, epic),  
             goto, sort, grouping, clear, new, rebalance, help                  

EVERYWHERE
F1      this help; ? is typed text here; / finds in it                          
ctrl-c  quit
